data.summary: The everyday crew in deep garment-dyed black.

children.text: The same classic crew cut in a rich black that stays black — garment-dyed after sewing so the colour goes all the way through. Mid-weight, soft from the first wear.
Fabric: 100% organic ringspun cotton, 200 gsm, garment-dyed and pre-shrunk. Machine wash cold, tumble dry low. Unisex fit — see the size guide for measurements.
